summary: Appeal against death sentence confirmation; prosecution failed to establish accused's presence during crime; bathroom location accessible to public; forensic evidence insufficient to link accused to murder and rape; High Court erred in confirming death penalty without conclusive proof; conviction set aside due to lack of direct evidence and reasonable doubt.
legal_provisions_cited: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection) Act, 2000 s.23
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; death sentence and conviction set aside; accused acquitted due to benefit of reasonable doubt.
